name: Collapsing Cell
description: A section of ceiling and iron cell bars collapse inward.
disable: DC 22 Thievery (trained) or DC 25 Crafting (trained) to use a loose iron bar to shore up the ceiling.

offensiveAbilities.name: Collapse
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A Medium or larger creature moves through the cell at a faster pace than simply Stepping, or more than one Medium or larger creature enter the cell at the same time

Effect The ceiling and walls of the cell collapse, creating a thunderous roar. All creatures in the cell must attempt a DC 25 Reflex Saving Throw save; the cell then becomes greater difficult terrain that can be passed through safely.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes (1d10+6) Bludgeoning Damage damage.

Failure The creature takes (2d10+13) Bludgeoning Damage damage and is Immobilized by fallen rubble (Escape dc=25).

Critical Failure The creature is buried in the rubble. They take (3d10+19) Bludgeoning Damage damage and are Restrained (Escape dc=25). Until they escape, the creature must hold their breath or risk suffocating.

Effect: Remaining Air
